_meta.title: Incubators for the pilot districts (Chennai region, Coimbatore, Madurai) and nearby

fields.district: Pilot district the incubator serves; region notes when it sits just outside (e.g. Chengalpattu for Chennai metro)
fields.pin: Pin code of the campus, used to place it against hotspot zones
fields.sectors: Vanigam sector ids from the incubator's stated focus; 'general' means technology startups broadly
fields.programmes: Government programmes the incubator is part of, through which money reaches startups
fields.confidence: official = incubator or government site; secondary = reputable listing; to_verify = needs a call or site check
fields.website: The incubator's own site, checked by hand on 4 Oct 2026; null where none could be confirmed. Read weekly for intake by scripts/check_incubator_intake.py

programme_notes.SISFS: Startup India Seed Fund: up to ₹20L grant (proof of concept, prototype) and up to ₹50L convertible debt or debentures, paid by the incubator in milestones. DPIIT-recognised, incorporated within 2 years, under ₹10L prior government support.
programme_notes.NIDHI-PRAYAS: DST: up to ₹10L to turn an idea into a prototype, up to 18 months, through a PRAYAS centre.
programme_notes.NIDHI-SSS: DST Seed Support System: seed capital invested by the TBI in its incubatees.
programme_notes.BioNEST: BIRAC (DBT) bio-incubator: labs and equipment; incubatees prepare BIRAC BIG applications (up to ₹50L over 18 months, calls on 1 January and 1 July).
programme_notes.AIC: Atal Incubation Centre under AIM, NITI Aayog.
programme_notes.RKVY-RAFTAAR: Agri ministry: up to ₹5L idea/pre-seed after a two-month orientation (startup bears 10%), up to ₹25L seed for incubatees with an MVP.
programme_notes.TIDE 2.0: MeitY: EiR stipend up to ₹4L (idea stage) or grant up to ₹7L (prototype) for ICT startups.
programme_notes.NABARD: NABARD-promoted agri-business incubation; MABIF lists seed grants up to ₹25L.

incubators.name: CIET Technology Business Incubator

incubators.name: SNS iHub
